issues.title: Kbd glyph collision
issues.description: The keyboard shortcut glyphs inside the secondary button overlap each other.
issues.evidence: The 'S' and '⌘' characters collide inside the draft save button.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal gap between key glyphs.
issues.triageNote: Real: inside an RTL parent the bidi algorithm reorders the '⌘S' glyphs (⌘ is direction-neutral) so they render inverted/cramped; fixed by isolating Kbd content with a default dir="ltr".

issues.title: Inverted shortcut modifier order in RTL
issues.description: Modifier keys appear after trigger keys inside shortcut badges rather than preceding them.
issues.evidence: Search bar displays 'K Ctrl' instead of 'Ctrl K'; bottom action displays 'S ⌘' instead of '⌘ S'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure shortcut container retains LTR ordering for key combinations in RTL contexts.
issues.triageNote: Real: RTL flex row on KbdGroup places first DOM child (Ctrl) on the right, rendering 'K Ctrl'; and '⌘S' inside a single Kbd reorders to 'S ⌘'. Fixed with default dir="ltr" on both Kbd and KbdGroup (same class of bug as pair-058).
